svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop with a waybar along the bottom. The view zooms into the bar and visits its widgets: a pomodoro timer starts, do not disturb turns on and the song title hides itself, a meeting recorder lights up, dictation types a comment into the editor, a build turns the Switchyard signal amber, the Roundhouse lamp turns red and its drawer explains that memory is stalling, the key lights warm the room, and the clock switches time zones.

g.text: // back off and retry, give up after five tries

hides itself too, so songs stay off screen shares
voxtype types it where the cursor is
one heavy build at a time
memory is stalling, so the next build waits
click the lamp to see why
both Elgato lights in one click
